_doc: ROI-average fits for the three-rater test-retest (in-house_toolbox dce_testretest_3rater.py).
Same settings as testretest_run_config.json, but fit_voxels is false: the concentration curve is
averaged over each ROI and that one curve is fitted (average-then-fit), written to *_rois.xls.
roi_files: the brain mask (first; defines the converted voxels), the tumor ROI (from
--regions-root regions_SG) and the WM mask. No parameter maps are written.
